name: Local Surface Construction with Multiple Connection Handling
definition: Constructs surfaces from local convexities (two connected clusters in different slices). Handles non-convex objects by dividing branching/merging connections into 1:1 connections to avoid surface smoothing or duplication.
summary: Local Surface Construction with Multiple Connection Handling divides branched clusters via eigen-analysis to create distinct 1:1 connections, preventing the surface smoothing and patch duplication caused by standard 3D hull algorithms on non-convex objects.
